card.name: Words introducing case reports
card.fires_on: Short opening words such as Two, there, one, an or have that start a statement that reports occurred, usually just before 'reports', 'cases' or 'incidents' in adverse-reaction text.

modes.label: Count or 'there' before reports
modes.description: A number or 'there' begins a sentence saying cases or reports exist.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is<< one>> report of acute overdosage with use

modes.label: Verb or article before reported events
modes.description: 'have' or 'an' sits just before 'been reported' or a reaction term.
modes.example: False-positive urine immunoassay screening tests for phencyclidine (PCP) and amphetamine<< have>> been reported in patients taking venlaf

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like incident, incidents and case.
card.plain: It marks the small word that opens a sentence about reported cases or events.
